author: spidey simp
description: An in-development random selection utility for creating reusable groups of names, numbers, members, and other items and selecting random entries from them.
install_msg: SpideyRandom is currently under development and is not ready for general use.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs and user-created random groups, including group names, descriptions, settings, and list contents.
